senses.gloss: m. (v. מָצַר I) anything twisted of rushes, palm-twigs &c. חבל מ׳ a common rope (badge of disgrace worn by the Sotah, v. סוֹטָה).
units: Sot. I, 6; a. fr.—[Y. ib. I, 17ᵃ top; Num. R. s. 9 take our w. to mean Egyptian, v. next w.].—Fem. מִצְרִית.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 2:1">Sot. II, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>כפיפה מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K01019"><he>כְּפִיפָה</he></cite>.
